generation.image_prompt: [CLEAN_V3_STRICT_NO_BORDERS] 1900s mystical lithography, bold ink outlines. ANTHROPOMORPHIC: A Taiwan leopard cat standing upright on two legs in a desolate winter landscape. He is wearing a detailed, worn 1900s traveling outfit with a heavy tattered cloak, tunic, and trousers. He leans on crutches. Five golden pentacles are integrated into a stained-glass window of a stone building in the background. Full bleed. No borders. High-fidelity biological markers. 2:3 vertical. Full bleed. No borders.
generation.narrative: The Five of Pentacles is 'The Lean Season'—the struggle for survival during drought or winter when prey is scarce and habitat quality is poor.

meanings.upright: Material hardship, struggle, isolation, and survival crisis due to habitat loss.
meanings.reversed: Restlessness, burnout, or a return to world before full recovery.

ecology.zh: 棲地樣貌：遭受災難後荒廢的貧瘠之地。生存威脅：物資匱乏導致的族群饥荒。牌義關聯：金幣五代表著「物質的艱辛」——在寒冷的冬夜或受損的棲地中，石虎族群艱難地互相取暖求生。
ecology.en: Habitat: 受保護的森林洞穴/樹洞. Risk: 壓力導致的免疫力下降. Note: Five of Pentacles represents 'Ecological Isolation'—leopard cats struggling in degraded habitats with insufficient prey and harsh conditions.
